title: Thali 4/4?
format: Kitty Gang checklist on the Tilak Ki Taiyari game: the tilak thali fills up with the four prize groups

experiment.hook: Tanya in a rush on the Tilak Ki Taiyari home art, heartbeat at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above, chip 'THALI: 0/4' pinned from the first frame, she says 'Tilak ki thali! Chaar cheezein, jaldi!'
experiment.variable: a visible progress counter: the theme's four prize groups (Kumkum, Chawal, Kalava, Nariyal) are the four things the tilak thali needs, and a 'THALI x/4' chip ticks up on every shot, so the middle always shows how close the payoff is
experiment.hypothesis: an open checklist the viewer can see filling (like a progress bar) holds people through the middle on a festival morning they are living: watched % above 20 (best so far 18), skip under 60%, at least 1 share

idea: Tanya needs the tilak thali ready and every friend fills one prize group: Megha gets Kumkum, Shruti is happy Chawal needs only 3 numbers, Myra asks why Kalava needs 5, and Nariyal is stuck until late Avika rushes in and the last number makes Full House. Aditi closes: har saal yahi hota hai.
beats: hook: thali 0/4, chaar cheezein jaldi / 1/4 Megha Kumkum / 2/4 Shruti Chawal bachat / 3/4 Myra Kalava confused, call 61 / stuck: Nariyal kahan? Avika! / turn: Avika arrives, call 9, Full House 4/4 / button: Aditi deadpan
caption: Tilak ki thali mein sabse late kya aata hai? Hamare group mein toh Avika aur Nariyal! Us saheli ko tag karo jo har saal late aati hai. Aaj ki {theme} Housie mein thali kiski poori?

lines.text: Tilak ki thali! Chaar cheezein, jaldi!
lines.say: तिलक की थाली! चार चीज़ें, जल्दी!

lines.text: Chawal sirf teen number mein. Bachat!
lines.say: चावल सिर्फ तीन नंबर में। बचत!

lines.text: Hmm. Har saal yahi hota hai.
lines.say: हम्म। हर साल यही होता है।
